parts.text: Define what is meant by electric potential at a point.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
In an $\alpha$-particle scattering experiment, $\alpha$-particles are directed towards a thin film of gold, as illustrated in Fig. 9.1.

{{figure:figure_9_1.png}}

The apparatus is in a vacuum.

The gold-197 ($^{197}_{79}\text{Au}$) nuclei in the film may be considered to be fixed point charges.

The $\alpha$-particles emitted from the source each have an energy of $4.8\text{MeV}$.

Calculate:
parts.text: the initial kinetic energy $E_{K}$, in $\text{J}$, of an $\alpha$-particle emitted from the source

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: the distance $d$ of closest approach of an $\alpha$-particle to a gold nucleus.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Use your answer in **(b)(ii)** to comment on the possible diameter of a gold nucleus.
